nodes.summary: Let $V$ be a combinatorial subspace of $\alpha^\iota$ with parameter set $\eta$ and let $W$ be a combinatorial subspace of $\alpha^\eta$ with parameter set $\eta'$; view each subspace as its map from parameter values to points. Then for every $x \in \alpha^{\eta'}$, the composite $V \circ W$ sends $x$ to $V(W(x))$.
nodes.title: Evaluating a composite subspace

nodes.summary: Let $V$ be a combinatorial subspace of $\alpha^\iota$ with parameter set $\eta$, let $W$ be a combinatorial subspace of $\alpha^\eta$ with parameter set $\eta'$, and let $l$ be a combinatorial line in $\alpha^{\eta'}$. Then the image of $l$ under the composite $V \circ W$ equals the image under $V$ of the image of $l$ under $W$, that is, $(V \circ W)_* l = V_*(W_* l)$.
nodes.title: Images of lines under composite subspaces

nodes.summary: Let $V$ be a combinatorial subspace of $\alpha^\iota$ with parameter set $\eta$, viewed as its map $x \mapsto V(x)$ from parameter values to points, and let $l$ be a combinatorial line in $\alpha^\eta$, with $l(a)$ the point of $l$ whose free coordinates equal $a$. Then for every $a \in \alpha$, the point at $a$ of the image line $V_* l$ is $V(l(a))$.

nodes.title: Graham–Rothschild theorem for combinatorial lines

nodes.summary: Let $l$ be a combinatorial line in $\alpha^\iota$, let $e : \iota \to \iota'$ be a bijection, and for $a \in \alpha$ write $l(a) \in \alpha^\iota$ for the point of $l$ whose free coordinates equal $a$. Then for every $a \in \alpha$ and every $j \in \iota'$, the $j$-th coordinate of the point at $a$ of the reindexing of $l$ along $e$ equals the $e^{-1}(j)$-th coordinate of $l(a)$.
nodes.title: Points of a reindexed line

Let $V^e$ be the combinatorial subspace of $\alpha^{\iota'}$ with parameter set $\eta$ that assigns to each coordinate $j \in \iota'$ what $V$ assigns to the coordinate $e^{-1}(j)$. nodes.title: Reindexing commutes with images of lines

nodes.summary: A combinatorial line $l$ in $\alpha^\iota$ assigns to each coordinate $i \in \iota$ either a fixed value in $\alpha$ or the free variable, with at least one free coordinate. Given a bijection $e : \iota \to \iota'$, the reindexing of $l$ along $e$ is the combinatorial line in $\alpha^{\iota'}$ that assigns to each coordinate $j \in \iota'$ what $l$ assigns to the coordinate $e^{-1}(j)$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
